testimonials.texto: An absolutely incredible experience! Moises and the team made us feel like family from the moment we arrived. We saw caimans, capybaras, monkeys and even spotted a jaguar on the riverbank. The lodge was cozy and the food was amazing. We couldn't recommend Manu Jungle Forever enough!

Truly a once-in-a-lifetime trip. Our guide knew every bird call and footprint in the jungle. The Blanquillo macaw clay lick was a highlight I will never forget. Absolutely worth every penny. Professional, safe, and deeply authentic.

Perfect company for your Amazon adventure. The guides were knowledgeable, the lodge beautiful, and the nature overwhelming. Even in 3 days we saw so much wildlife. We are already planning to come back for the 6-day tour!

Manu Jungle Forever exceeded all expectations. The expedition felt genuinely wild — camping by the river, fishing for piranhas, learning to navigate by the stars. A real adventure with a safety-first approach. Five stars without hesitation.

As a wildlife photographer, I have been on many jungle tours around the world. Manu Jungle Forever is in a league of its own. The locations, the knowledge of the guides, and the access to pristine habitats resulted in the best wildlife shots of my career.

We chose Manu Jungle Forever because of the personal touch — a real family business. Moises was our guide and his stories about growing up in the jungle made every moment magical. We saw giant otters, macaws, and countless species of birds.
